tasks.goal: Establish one normalized mock fact model for clearance, production outcomes and current production
input_facts: types.ts and mock.ts are the release state and derivation owners
All data remains fictional session state
invariants: Current production derives only from successful history
Version strings are not semantically compared
interface_contracts: One fact model drives all projections
Emergency assignment is fixed after approval
non_goals: No backend, database or real integration
action_bounds: Only revise release domain types, mock facts and pure derivations
acceptance_checks: All version types, characteristics and outcomes are expressible
Successful-history rollback returns the previous version
tasks.rollback: Restore revision 1 types.ts and mock.ts together.
stop_conditions: A shared platform type or backend implementation is required
escalation_conditions: Approved rules cannot be represented without changing the scope

tasks.goal: Deliver the five-view shell, window eligibility and complete application interactions
input_facts: Normal /release must not show debug controls
invariants: One application contains one subsystem and at least one unit
Emergency-dependent hidden fields do not validate
interface_contracts: Views receive the shared state by props/events
Conflict decisions are explicit user actions
Window options expose status and disabled reason
non_goals: No AppLayout, global CSS or common UI edits
action_bounds: Only update release shell, application/window components and scoped styles
acceptance_checks: Emergency and non-emergency forms show the correct fields
Three historical conflict statuses expose the correct choices
tasks.rollback: Restore the revision 1 release shell, application/window components and CSS.
stop_conditions: Shared shell changes are needed for core usability
escalation_conditions: Approved content cannot fit supported viewports within module styles

tasks.goal: Deliver window production baselines, current production versions and reconciled analytics
input_facts: T7 owns the shared session state
invariants: Latest window candidate uses approval time
Only successful production updates current production
interface_contracts: Baseline emits one audited result command
Current production is a read-only projection
Charts and drill-down use the same metric source
non_goals: No server persistence or real export
action_bounds: Only update the three release projections, shell integration and scoped styles
acceptance_checks: Success, failure and not-produced outcomes remain distinct
Changing success to failure returns the previous production version
Statistics canvases and rows render from shared facts
tasks.rollback: Remove the current-production view and restore revision 1 baseline, analytics and shell integration.
stop_conditions: A second mutable current-version state becomes necessary
escalation_conditions: Core projection cannot be demonstrated without persistence

tasks.goal: Deliver one authenticated responsive workflow review route with current-login signature
input_facts: Authenticated child routes can be hidden from menus
Release review facts are available from the mock repository
invariants: One route serves Web and H5
Only a valid current assignee can act
Signature identity is the current login user
interface_contracts: Route contains taskId, businessType and businessId
Approve, reject and return are guarded against duplicate submission
non_goals: No real workflow calls, separate H5 route or external signature
action_bounds: Add one hidden authenticated route and release-scoped page, links, facts and styles
acceptance_checks: Approve, reject and return controls are reachable
375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 have no page-level horizontal overflow
evidence_required: Desktop and phone DOM and interaction observations
tasks.rollback: Delete the review page and remove its route, links and mock task facts.
stop_conditions: An unauthenticated route or shared shell edit is required
escalation_conditions: Real platform workflow behavior becomes an acceptance prerequisite

tasks.goal: Verify the complete revision-2 implementation and preserve independent control evidence
invariants: Observed results distinguish automated, backend and browser sensors
No commit or push is performed
interface_contracts: Control artifacts use the plugin schemas
Final report links every requirement to tasks and sensors
non_goals: No product expansion during evidence recording
action_bounds: Run declared checks and write requirement-prefixed evidence only
acceptance_checks: Frontend build, governance, Flyway and diff checks pass
Full Maven reactor passes under Java 17
Desktop and three phone viewports satisfy required paths
evidence_required: Browser DOM, canvas, console and interaction results
tasks.rollback: Remove only revision-2 control files and restore handoff approval metadata if user revokes approval.
stop_conditions: Any must requirement, P0/P1, scope or regression gate fails
escalation_conditions: Completion requires backend, database or shared-platform changes
